entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [aw] Failed jobs: ResourceLock refactoring #56366
  • dotnet format - AllReferencedProjectsLoadedAsync does not track already evaluated projects #56363

Closed

  • no logo description for dotnet test (MTP) is wrong #56285
  • `StaticWebAssetFingerprintPattern` defined in WasmBrowser templates is visible in the project tree #56358
